question: Should OpenClaw adopt the proposed one-Claw-one-new-agent package, lifecycle, and compatibility contract as RFC 0016?
rationale: Document correctness cannot decide whether OpenClaw should permanently support this new CLI, manifest, package-ownership, provenance, update, and removal model.

options.title: Accept the current v1 contract
options.body: Approve the current scope, create the implementation issue, transition the RFC to accepted, and merge it while implementation remains experimentally gated.

options.title: Narrow the initial contract
options.body: Defer selected update, export, MCP, cron, or shared-package semantics and accept a smaller compatibility surface.

options.title: Continue draft incubation
options.body: Keep the RFC open as a draft until the linked implementation stack supplies additional upgrade and lifecycle evidence.

recommendation.title: Accept the current v1 contract
recommendation.body: Approve the current scope, create the implementation issue, transition the RFC to accepted, and merge it while implementation remains experimentally gated.

likelyOwner.reason: They supplied the strongest visible product-model review and the current proposal was substantially revised around that feedback.
